messages.subject: Default Cartesian to Y axis origin = 0?
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know how to set the default cartesian Y axis range (min) 0 but leave the upper end open so it auto-scales? 
It would speed up my workflow immensely if I could just stamp a 0 minimum and leave the max to be 'autodetected'.
If I leave the upper range empty, R ignores the y axis range setting completely.

many thanks
Kieran
